description: Get or update the requester profile used on vendor trust-center access forms (requires trustlists_login). Pass fullName, company, role, phone, and termsAccepted to save. Returns complete/missing so a blocked access request can be fixed in chat.

fullName.description: First and last name on vendor forms.

termsAccepted.description: Permission to accept vendor terms on the user's behalf.

name: trustlists_requester_profile
